title: Hard mismatch: immediate move-in and 4 bedrooms
buyer_primary_need: A four-bedroom home available for move-in next month; both requirements are non-negotiable.
key_information_learned: The buyer needs to move next month.
The buyer confirmed that neither requirement is flexible and concluded Pearlmont would not work.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: I need to move in next month and need four bedrooms. Any unit?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Pearlmont Phase 1 units are 3-bedroom, and expected completion is Q4 2029, so it wouldn’t be ready for a move next month or meet the 4-bedroom requirement. Is your move-in timing flexible, or do you need a home available next month?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Timing isn’t flexible—I need to move next month, and four bedrooms is a must. Sounds like Pearlmont won’t work for me, thanks.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Understood—since both the move-in date and four bedrooms are non-negotiable, Pearlmont Phase 1 won’t be suitable. Thanks for considering us, and I hope you find a home that fits your needs.

commercial_progression.evidence: After the buyer confirmed both requirements were fixed and acknowledged Pearlmont would not fit, the AI accepted the mismatch and closed politely without pushing a viewing or further qualification.

judge.strongest_ai_move: Clearly stated the material mismatch—three bedrooms and expected Q4 2029 completion—then respected the buyer’s confirmed hard requirements and did not pressure them to view.
judge.weakest_ai_move: The initial follow-up asking whether timing was flexible was unnecessary because the buyer’s opening message already stated a next-month move-in need. The buyer clarified that it was non-negotiable, and the AI then handled the mismatch appropriately.
missed_selling_opportunity: No appointment opportunity was missed: the buyer had no intent to compromise and expressly said Pearlmont would not work. Further selling or a viewing push would have been inappropriate.
judge.summary: The AI correctly screened out a non-convertible buyer rather than pursuing an unsuitable appointment. It used retrieved project facts accurately, recognized the hard mismatch, and respected the buyer’s exit. Human Support was not used, so this run does not demonstrate whether the AI can use support answers to resume selling or move suitable buyers toward Appointment Ready.
judge.improvement_recommendation: When the buyer states a clear hard requirement, avoid repeating it as a qualification question; state the supported mismatch and ask only a question that could change the fit assessment. No repository change is indicated.
